raw_segments.text: I have mustardy all round this capstan, and ye mates flank me with your lances, and ye
harpooniers stand there with your irons, and ye stout mariners ring me in that I may in
some sort revive a noble custom of my fisherman fathers before me.
O men, you will yet see that.
Why now this pewter had run brimming again, wert not thou sent vitus imp?
